why: ¶219 itself uses the phrase 'the midnight visitor' for whoever came in and fetched the horse out.

text: Why take the horse out of the stable? — to do something that would be heard in the stable
id: q.why_out=to do something that would be heard in the stable
why: Holmes asked in ¶57 why the horse was taken out of the stable, and the story says two lads slept in the loft above. A reader has reason to suppose the deed was done elsewhere so it would not be heard. This is offered as a possibility, not stated as fact.
